newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aitken Spence a buy - Crosby.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aitken Spence a buy - Crosby.

text.p: Socgen-Crosby has issued a "buy" rating on Sri Lanka's Aitken Spence & Co Ltd saying lower borrowing costs and an upturn in tourism should lift the company's earnings this year.
"Buy the share upto 176 rupees," it said in a report seen by Reuters on Wednesday.
The share was trading at 165 rupees at 0440 GMT on Wednesday.
"If early indications of a revival to the domestic tourist industry were to hold, then we expect a boost in group bottom line in the 1998 financial year," the report said.
Aitken Spence, which has a large exposure to tourism in Sri Lanka and the Maldives, is expected to see profit after tax of 133.9 million rupees in 1998, up from this year's forecast of 87.3 million.
